items.reason: The theorem excludes stage sequences with the declared finite-affine-cover subsequential regularity. Non-affine Mobius profiles on a positive-length interval do not have a finite affine cover, so the intended choreography is outside that hypothesis. Actual implementation still has to be checked; no tape implementation is inferred from the abstract coordinate map. The exceptional allowance is an asymptotic constant, not a superlinear toll.

An explicit one-node clock works for every T <= cP when family constants can be chosen: B=J=a=1,rho=0,C=c,V(root)=cP, all other volumes zero, root stage [0,T), all other stages empty. This does not assert that every prescribed choice of clock parameters works. The physical bound is a sum of omitted head-times, not travelled distance. Half-scan language is restricted to the nominal P/G-cell footprint.

Credit the affine-group Folner property and amenability, while identifying the Lean proof as a direct finite-boundary construction. Cite Lubotzky-Weiss only as related amenability/expansion context. Do not assert that arbitrary non-affine Mobius maps generate a free non-amenable group: that depends on the chosen generators.

Move the AffineTimeRequired annotation from the star definition to prose that actually defines its quantified omitted-measure property. Mark the physical-units theorem as assembled. State its common-region clause in the exported connected-component form, explain equivalence to local affinity for open subsets of R, and cite the original native M* endpoint supplying SatisfiesStar. No new Lean theorem or strengthened theorem claim was added.

State explicitly that the first paper contains a common-triangle-wave observation but no affine-motion theorem, and that this obstruction uses only S=empty and 0<theta<1/2. Parent handles corresponding verified-results.txt edits.

unformalized_explanatory_checks.argument: The root owns all ticks, T<=cP=aV(root); children have zero volume and all other stages are empty, so every defining field holds. No geometric regularity follows.

unformalized_explanatory_checks.claim: Local affine iff affine on components for open real sets
unformalized_explanatory_checks.argument: Each component is an open interval. Affine coefficients are unique on a nonempty open interval. Thus the locally defined coefficient pair is locally constant, hence constant on a connected component. The reverse implication follows because the component itself is an open neighborhood.

unformalized_explanatory_checks.claim: A non-affine Mobius profile has no finite affine cover on a positive-length interval
unformalized_explanatory_checks.argument: For q(x)=(ax+b)/(cx+d), ad-bc != 0 and c != 0, equality to mx+n on an open interval forces the polynomial coefficients c*m=0, c*n+d*m=a, d*n=b. These give m=0 and ad-bc=0, a contradiction. A finite interval cover of a positive-length interval must contain a positive-length piece.
